problem: Find the global maximum of the function $f(x,y)=2x{e}^{y}-{x}^{2}-2{e}^{y}$ on the closed square $D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,0\le y\le 1}.$ You're given that $f$ has a critical point at $(1,0)$ and on the boundary of the square the points that could give rise to extreme values are the vertices.

activity_context.topic_title: Calculating Global Extrema of Multivariable Functions
